plugin.name: I have read and understand the above warnings
plugin.description:
If you use Uneducated Shooter (https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/81498), you MUST disable the inertia from that mod or your first person arms WILL BREAK in-game. Files with correct settings are provided in this download, but you must make sure you:
1. Overwrite any settings files from Uneducated Shooter if you have that installed. 2. Delete any settings files for Uneducated Shooter in your MO2 Overwrite folder. They are provided with this mod.
You may need to redo your lean settings in-game if you changed them from default. Please do NOT post comments about this if you don't read or follow these instructions. Thanks and happy modding!
Selecting this option installs the full FP Gunplay Overhaul package (F4SE plugin, INI, presets, PDB) and safe Uneducated Shooter MCM override settings (inertia disabled).

plugin.name: Cancel - I do not agree / will not follow these instructions
plugin.description:
Select this if you do not agree to the warnings above or do not intend to follow the Uneducated Shooter instructions.
No files will be installed.
